items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...To carry Shields and Emil Christian with him. [INTERVIEWEE] Sure enough? I was playing with that too. I was one of those pictures. Who? Shields.

ctx.x: I took Sharky right over here at Blutsey, I played a week's engagement there. I took him over there. And he couldn't play on three home. He couldn't play much. I told him to play, keep fighting. I could listen to him, just keep fighting. He did. Years later, I heard that he was doing pretty good.
Oh yeah? He still is, he does alright. He's been out to Texas for a week. To carry Shields and Emil Christian with him.
Sure enough? I was playing with that too. I was one of those pictures. Who? Shields.
